{{Quote|If we can't have it, no one can.|The leader of the Ossiki Confederacy, on destroying food supplies during the seasonal wars|<ref name="Characters" />}}
The '''Toydarian seasonal wars''' were a recurring cycle of conflicts between the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarians]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]]. The wars were driven by the planet's climate, as roughly once every thirty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] conditions such as famines and droughts limited [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] availability. Various factions were involved in the conflicts, including rival confederacies and subjects of the Toydarian [[Monarchy/Legends|monarchy]]. During one of the wars, the [[Ossiki Confederacy Army]] became infamous for [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] and destroying rival food supplies. The wars often ended once Toydaria's climate improved.

==Prelude==
[[File:Toydaria_TEA.jpg|thumb|right|260px|Toydaria's climate cycle led to repeated wars.]]
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]<ref name="Aliens">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> had a cyclical climate that led to poor growing seasons and subsequent famines<ref name="Characters" /> approximately once every thirty [[Standard year/Legends|standard years]].<ref name="Aliens" /> The native Toydarian's [[Diet/Legends|diet]] consisted of large quantities of high energy [[Sugar/Legends|sugar]]-rich [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]],<ref name="Characters" /> and many Toydarians worked as [[Fisher/Legends|fishers]] and [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] in [[Tree/Legends|tree]]-top villages. These citizens gathered their food between [[Water/Legends|flood]] seasons on behalf of their local [[Lord/Legends|lords]], and the majority of their crops were transported offworld as tribute to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Devastating monsoons and crop-[[Death/Legends|killing]] spores also caused food shortages,<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" /> leading to skirmishes.<ref name="Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> and escalating into wars.<ref name="Characters" />

Toydarians became accustomed to squabbling over resources<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" /> and often felt that stealing from their neighbors or even [[Poison/Legends|poisoning]] their food was the most effective method of survival in [[Time/Legends|times]] of difficulty, which escalated into the formation of [[Army/Legends|armies]].<ref name="Aliens" /> Responsibility fell to the [[King/Legends|king]] of Toydaria to resolve the conflicts.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" /> Among the factions involved in the wars were rival confederacies, including the [[Ossiki Confederacy]],<ref name="Characters" /> along with individuals such as fiefdom servants and Toydarian vassals.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" /> 

==The wars==
The rival Toydarian confederacies fought bitterly during the conflicts. Many Toydarians,<ref name="Aliens" /> including the [[Ossiki's leader|leader]] of the Ossiki Confederacy, believed that other groups should be denied food if they were unable to claim it.<ref name="Characters" /> As a result, the [[Ossiki Confederacy Army]] became infamous for using chemical [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]]<ref name="CSWE Ossiki">{{CSWECite|II|427|Ossiki Confederacy Army}}</ref> to poison<ref name="Characters" /> and destroy the food supplies of rival confederacies.<ref name="CSWE Ossiki" /> Rival clans participated in the conflict as well.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Wattoep2promotionalfull.jpg|thumb|left|245px|Watto (pictured) fought in the wars in his youth and received lifelong injuries.]]
During a period of drought within the [[Great Peace of the Republic]], the young Toydarian [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] joined the Ossiki Confederacy Army. He was permanently injured in the conflict, receiving a broken left [[Tooth/Legends|tusk]] and a crippled [[Limb/Legends|leg]]. The war ended when the drought rescinded,<ref name="Characters" /> and Watto left the army to settle on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]<ref name="CSWE Watto">{{CSWECite|III|322|Watto}}</ref> by approximately [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]].<ref name="Watto date">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']] states that [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] was present on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] not long after [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived there when he was roughly three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old. The book also states that Skywalker was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[41 BBY/Legends|41 BBY]]. Therefore, Watto had settled on Tatooine by approximately [[38 BBY/Legends|38 BBY]].</ref> The Toydarian [[Monarchy/Legends|King]] [[Maalva]],<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" /> whose reign began in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]<ref name="TCW date">''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'' states that [[King/Legends|King]] [[Maalva]] succeeded the [[Throne/Legends|throne]] of [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]] after the [[Showdown at Toydaria/Legends|assassination]] of his uncle, [[Monarchy/Legends|King]] [[Katuunko/Legends|Katuunko]], which was portrayed in "[[Witches of the Mist]]." {{TCWdates|314}}</ref> and continued into the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], allowed his vassals to settle their conflicts on their own, and occassionally incited quarrels to consolidate his own power.<ref name="Lords of Nal Hutta" />

Some wars over food supplies were among the [[Blood/Legends|bloodiest]] in Toydaria's history.<ref name="Scum">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref> In the pattern of the seasonal wars, they ended once conditions improved<ref name="Aliens" /> or supply issues were resolved, and life for the Toydarians quickly returned to normal<ref name="Alien">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> until the next resource scarcity.<ref name="Aliens" /> Outside of the wars, the Toydarians had a quiet existence during the Imperial Period, and Toydaria was a sleepy corner of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by the time of the [[New Jedi Order]].<ref name="Alien Anthology" /> The Toydarians' culture of warfare was acknowledged in the anthropological texts ''[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''<ref name="Alien" /> and [[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species (book)|''The New Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], both published by the time of [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] control of the galaxy and based on the findings of [[Senior Anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]].<ref name="Aliens" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Toydarian seasonal wars were first mentioned in [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']] by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]], published in [[2001]].<ref name="Alien" /> They were first identified by name in the Ossiki Confederacy Army's entry in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]].<ref name="CSWE Ossiki" />
